title: The Algorithm Ate My Homework
setup: WOOF7 blames the resistance for spoiled food using edited delivery footage. The restored supply loses public trust faster than the crew can replenish it.
escalation: Ghost recovers the original recording from the network's archive but risks identifying their old courier contacts. The Shiba anchor claims the clip arrived already edited. Byte tracks the edit order to the corporate media director's office, keeping responsibility specific.
resolution: NIP7 airs the original footage beside the ordered edits and independently checks storage temperatures. The crew releases their distribution logs, including one real mistake. Trust returns because they correct their own error as well as expose the lie.
continuity: The anchor remains compromised and afraid. Ghost's route is now known to Fetch. The evidence points to corporate coordination, not a sentient AI yet.
comedy: Trixie records an apology in fourteen takes; the honest accidental take is the only useful one.
ending_hook: The unedited archive contains an invitation to a private board demonstration by Dr Muzzle.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
